name: secondmind
description: Portable, cross-session AI memory. Zero required dependencies. One memory. Every AI. Any machine.
long_description: SecondMind is a local, zero-install memory layer: tell it something once and any MCP-compatible client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and others as they adopt the same standard) can recall it later, on any machine. Hybrid BM25+semantic search, conflict-safe writes, and a plain Markdown vault you fully own.

vault_dir.title: Vault location
vault_dir.description: Where SecondMind stores your notes as plain Markdown files. Defaults to a folder in your home directory — change it if you want your vault somewhere else (e.g. inside an existing Obsidian vault, or a synced folder).

index_db.title: Search index location
index_db.description: Where SecondMind keeps its rebuildable search index (SQLite). Safe to delete any time — it regenerates from the vault. Kept separate from vault_dir on purpose, so a vault pointed at an existing Obsidian folder never gets a stray database file mixed into your real notes.
